vulns.details: minimist is vulnerable to prototype pollution. Affected versions are >=1.0.0, <1.2.6. Users should upgrade; the issue is fixed in 1.2.6.
Versions from 0.0.1 up to 0.2.1 are affected. Patched in 0.2.1.
lodash versions >= 4.0.0 and < 4.17.21 are affected by prototype pollution via zipObjectDeep. Fixed in 4.17.21.
Affects versions since 6.0.0 before 6.1.9. Fixed in 6.1.9.
axios is affected by a cross-site request forgery issue. Fixed in 1.6.0.

vulns.summary: Advisory with no version information at all
vulns.details: This advisory deliberately states no versions. It exists so the pipeline has a case where extraction legitimately returns nothing, which is different from extraction failing. It should be stored with zero ranges and confidence 0, not dead-lettered.
